segments.normalizedSource: ```swift func session(_ session: ARSession, didOutputCollaborationData data: ARSession.CollaborationData) { guard let multipeerSession = multipeerSession else { return } if !multipeerSession.connectedPeers.isEmpty { guard let encodedData = try? NSKeyedArchiver.archivedData(withRootObject: data, requiringSecureCoding: true) else { fatalError("Unexpectedly failed to encode collaboration data.") } // Use reliable mode if the data is critical, and unreliable mode if the data is optional. let dataIsCritical = data.priority == .critical multipeerSession.sendToAllPeers(encodedData, reliably: dataIsCritical) } else { print("Deferred sending collaboration to later because there are no peers.") } } ```
